ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is restricted to the EOL Chicago EdM and CAS cohort that began Spr ?10. Class sessions will be held on these weekends & times at the Moody Bible Institute of Chicago on the following dates: Sep 3 & 4, Sep 24 & 25, Oct 15 & 16, Nov 19 & 20, & Dec 3 & 4; Fri 5:30-9:30 pm; Sat 8:00 am -4:30 pm. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
